liveness_fixture_health.probe_point: in the descendant, after any stdio release and setsid: the health FIFO is opened non-blocking, the liveness FIFO is confirmed by a non-blocking write open failing ENXIO, PROBE_REACHED is written, and only then does the direct child's gate pipe close; the blocking rendezvous follows
liveness_fixture_health.direct_child_gate: with a health channel, helper_fork's direct child exits once its descendant closed a close-on-exec gate pipe (or died), so the health token is buffered before the launcher can sweep; created after exec and never inherited through one
liveness_fixture_health.interpretation: no probe, a channel failure, a malformed or unreadable channel, or an unarmed channel is INVALID; only a reached probe with no failure lets a liveness byte mean descendant_survived and its bounded absence mean descendant_died
